info.name: model-failover e2e
info.description: End-to-end coverage for the model-failover gateway policy: multi-target-group dispatch, cross-cluster failover with per-attempt model rewrite, suspend-driven skip-ahead, unmatched-model passthrough, zero-fallback groups, registration-time validation (dangling upstreamDefinition references, model-failover+resilience.retry coexistence, basePath-carrying aggregate-cluster members), and LlmProxy cross-provider dispatch via additionalProviders aliases.

request.description: Two independent target groups: gpt-4o/gpt-4o-mini on primary/fallback-1, claude-3-5-sonnet/claude-3-haiku on anthropic-primary/anthropic-fallback-1.

body.raw:
apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProvider
metadata:
  name: model-failover-test
spec:
  displayName: Model Failover Test
  version: v1.0
  template: openai
  context: /model-failover-test/latest
  upstream:
    url: http://host.docker.internal:9711
  upstreamDefinitions:
    - name: primary
      upstreams:
        - url: http://host.docker.internal:9711
    - name: fallback-1
      upstreams:
        - url: http://host.docker.internal:9712
    - name: anthropic-primary
      upstreams:
        - url: http://host.docker.internal:9713
    - name: anthropic-fallback-1
      upstreams:
        - url: http://host.docker.internal:9714
  policies:
    - name: model-failover
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            targets:
              - model: gpt-4o
                upstreamDefinition: primary
                fallbacks:
                  - model: gpt-4o-mini
                    upstreamDefinition: fallback-1
              - model: claude-3-5-sonnet
                upstreamDefinition: anthropic-primary
                fallbacks:
                  - model: claude-3-haiku
                    upstreamDefinition: anthropic-fallback-1
            statusCodes: [500]
            requestTimeout: 5s
            suspendDuration: 10s
  accessControl:
    mode: deny_all
    exceptions:
      - path: /chat/completions
        methods: [POST]

item.name: Register: mf-proxy-zerofb-test (LlmProxy, model-keyed dispatch via additionalProviders aliases)

request.description: The ONLY safe LlmProxy model-failover pattern: zero-fallback groups dispatching by model to different provider aliases. Each additionalProviders alias resolves via the SAME loopback address, distinguished only by BasePath - which is exactly why a group WITH fallbacks can't safely use one (see folder 11).

body.raw:
apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: mf-proxy-zerofb-test
spec:
  displayName: MF Proxy Zero-Fallback Test
  version: v1.0
  context: /mf-proxy-zerofb-test
  provider:
    id: mf-proxy-primary-provider
  additionalProviders:
    - id: mf-proxy-primary-provider
      as: openai-alias
    - id: mf-proxy-anthropic-provider
      as: anthropic-alias
  policies:
    - name: model-failover
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            targets:
              - model: gpt-4o
                upstreamDefinition: openai-alias
              - model: claude-3-haiku
                upstreamDefinition: anthropic-alias
            statusCodes: [500]
  accessControl:
    mode: deny_all
    exceptions:
      - path: /chat/completions
        methods: [POST]

item.name: 12 - LlmProxy: Registration-time rejection of an unsafe loopback+fallback config
Reject: a fallback-having target group using loopback aliases

request.description: Both openai-alias and anthropic-alias resolve to the SAME loopback address, distinguished only by request path (BasePath). Envoy's aggregate-cluster retry can't vary the path per member, so a retry from openai-alias to anthropic-alias would silently land back on openai-alias while still relabeling the response as anthropic - confirmed live before this validator existed. Must be rejected with a clean 4xx, not persisted as a broken route.
